name: Theme from media
description: OKLab k-means, WCAG-pushed text roles, provenance flags. The palette read exists (SB2, D339: services/scene-builder/palette.mjs). SB4 (D345): services/scene-builder/theme.mjs turns a reference read into a studio theme pack (data/themes format, schema v2) that passes the T1 contrast check, every colour with its provenance. Overlay brand themes from media are not built yet, so this stays planned.
